Subject: Benefits Update: New Health Insurance Options Available
Body:
Dear All,

I'm writing to share several important updates from the People & Culture team at HP.

────────────────────────────────────────────
1. ANNUAL PERFORMANCE REVIEW — CYCLE OPENING
────────────────────────────────────────────
The annual performance review cycle will open on May 08, 2026. This year's updated framework includes:

• Self-assessment          — due May 20, 2026
• Manager review           — due May 28, 2026
• Calibration sessions     — week of May 22, 2026
• Final ratings communicated by May 07, 2026

All employees should ensure their goals are up-to-date in the performance system before the self-assessment opens.

────────────────────────────────────────────
2. BENEFITS ENROLLMENT WINDOW
────────────────────────────────────────────
The annual benefits enrollment window is open from May 06, 2026 to May 17, 2026. This is your opportunity to:

• Review and update your health insurance plan
• Adjust your pension/401k contribution rate
• Add or remove dependants
• Enrol in voluntary benefits (dental, vision, life)

Failure to make elections within the window will result in current selections rolling over automatically.

────────────────────────────────────────────
3. EMPLOYEE WELLBEING
────────────────────────────────────────────
As a reminder, HP offers all employees:
• Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) — free, confidential counselling
• Headspace for Work subscription — free access
• Monthly wellness stipend of $60 for gym/wellness expenses

Details on how to access these resources can be found on the HR Portal.

If you have any questions, please don't hesitate to reach out to the HR team.

Warm regards,
Linda Green
Head of People & Culture | HP
+1-477-188-4188

Take care,
Ethan Baker

Emma Sanchez

────────────────────────────────────────────
The annual performance review cycle will open on May 07, 2026. This year's updated framework includes:

The annual benefits enrollment window is open from May 06, 2026 to May 09, 2026. This is your opportunity to:

• Review and update your health insurance plan
• Adjust your pension/401k contribution rate
• Add or remove dependants
• Enrol in voluntary benefits (dental, vision, life)

Failure to make elections within the window will result in current selections rolling over automatically.

• Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) — free, confidential counselling
• Headspace for Work subscription — free access
• Monthly wellness stipend of $40 for gym/wellness expenses

Details on how to access these resources can be found on the HR Portal.

If you have any questions, please don't hesitate to reach out to the HR team.

Warm regards,
Ethan Perez

Subject: Company Update: Q4 All-Hands Meeting
Body:
Dear All,

I'm writing to share several important updates from the People & Culture team at Stripe.

────────────────────────────────────────────
1. ANNUAL PERFORMANCE REVIEW — CYCLE OPENING
────────────────────────────────────────────
The annual performance review cycle will open on May 09, 2026. This year's updated framework includes:

• Self-assessment          — due May 22, 2026
• Manager review           — due May 22, 2026
• Calibration sessions     — week of May 24, 2026
• Final ratings communicated by May 09, 2026

All employees should ensure their goals are up-to-date in the performance system before the self-assessment opens.

────────────────────────────────────────────
2. BENEFITS ENROLLMENT WINDOW
────────────────────────────────────────────
The annual benefits enrollment window is open from May 04, 2026 to May 06, 2026. This is your opportunity to:

• Review and update your health insurance plan
• Adjust your pension/401k contribution rate
• Add or remove dependants
• Enrol in voluntary benefits (dental, vision, life)

Failure to make elections within the window will result in current selections rolling over automatically.

────────────────────────────────────────────
3. EMPLOYEE WELLBEING
────────────────────────────────────────────
As a reminder, Stripe offers all employees:
• Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) — free, confidential counselling
• Headspace for Work subscription — free access
• Monthly wellness stipend of $97 for gym/wellness expenses

Details on how to access these resources can be found on the HR Portal.

If you have any questions, please don't hesitate to reach out to the HR team.

Warm regards,
Isabella Davis
Head of People & Culture | Stripe
+1-596-637-6838

Body:
Hey Elijah,

I hope this email finds you well! I know we've both been terrible at keeping in touch lately but I've been thinking about you and wanted to reach out properly rather than just sending a message that gets buried.

Work: Things have been really busy but rewarding. The team is great

Life: Finally got the flat sorted after the big move. It has been an adjustment but a good one overall.

Travel: Just got back from Greece before the year ends. Would love to have a travel buddy if you're free!

Anyway, I don't want this to turn into an essay. Let's actually make plans to catch up. Are you free for coffee sometime in the next couple of weeks? I'm flexible most evenings and weekends.

Would genuinely love to hear how you're doing.

Take care,
Patricia Perez

P.S. Still thinking about that great meal we had last time.

• Self-assessment          — due May 20, 2026
• Manager review           — due May 06, 2026

• Review and update your health insurance plan
• Adjust your pension/401k contribution rate
• Add or remove dependants
• Enrol in voluntary benefits (dental, vision, life)

Failure to make elections within the window will result in current selections rolling over automatically.

• Headspace for Work subscription — free access

If you have any questions, please don't hesitate to reach out to the HR team.

Warm regards,
Barbara Hernandez

Hey Barbara,

I hope this email finds you well! I know we've both been terrible at keeping in touch lately but I've been thinking about you and wanted to reach out properly rather than just sending a message that gets buried.

So — how are you? What's new? Fill me in!

On my end, things have been a whirlwind. Here's a brief update:

Work: Considering a career change — more on that soon. The team is great

Life: Finally got the flat sorted after the big move. It has been an adjustment but a good one overall.

Travel: Desperately need a holiday — eyeing Mexico in the spring. Would love to have a travel buddy if you're free!

Anyway, I don't want this to turn into an essay. Let's actually make plans to catch up. Are you free for coffee sometime in the next couple of weeks? I'm flexible most evenings and weekends.

Would genuinely love to hear how you're doing.

Take care,
James Ramirez

P.S. Still thinking about that great meal we had last time.

────────────────────────────────────────────

• Manager review           — due May 13, 2026

• Adjust your pension/401k contribution rate
• Add or remove dependants
• Enrol in voluntary benefits (dental, vision, life)

• Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) — free, confidential counselling
• Headspace for Work subscription — free access
• Monthly wellness stipend of $94 for gym/wellness expenses

Details on how to access these resources can be found on the HR Portal.

If you have any questions, please don't hesitate to reach out to the HR team.

Warm regards,

────────────────────────────────────────────
The annual performance review cycle will open on May 17, 2026. This year's updated framework includes:

• Self-assessment          — due May 05, 2026
• Manager review           — due May 09, 2026
• Calibration sessions     — week of May 23, 2026

────────────────────────────────────────────
The annual benefits enrollment window is open from May 08, 2026 to May 11, 2026. This is your opportunity to:

• Review and update your health insurance plan
• Adjust your pension/401k contribution rate
• Add or remove dependants
• Enrol in voluntary benefits (dental, vision, life)

Failure to make elections within the window will result in current selections rolling over automatically.

────────────────────────────────────────────

As a reminder, Salesforce offers all employees:
• Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) — free, confidential counselling
• Headspace for Work subscription — free access
• Monthly wellness stipend of $73 for gym/wellness expenses

Details on how to access these resources can be found on the HR Portal.

If you have any questions, please don't hesitate to reach out to the HR team.

Travel: Just got back from Morocco before the year ends. Would love to have a travel buddy if you're free!

Charles Moore

Dear All,

I'm writing to share several important updates from the People & Culture team at Atlassian.

────────────────────────────────────────────
1. ANNUAL PERFORMANCE REVIEW — CYCLE OPENING
────────────────────────────────────────────
The annual performance review cycle will open on May 10, 2026. This year's updated framework includes:

• Self-assessment          — due May 22, 2026
• Manager review           — due May 24, 2026
• Calibration sessions     — week of May 07, 2026
• Final ratings communicated by May 22, 2026

All employees should ensure their goals are up-to-date in the performance system before the self-assessment opens.

────────────────────────────────────────────
The annual benefits enrollment window is open from May 04, 2026 to May 12, 2026. This is your opportunity to:

• Review and update your health insurance plan
• Adjust your pension/401k contribution rate
• Add or remove dependants
• Enrol in voluntary benefits (dental, vision, life)

Failure to make elections within the window will result in current selections rolling over automatically.

────────────────────────────────────────────

────────────────────────────────────────────
As a reminder, Atlassian offers all employees:
• Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) — free, confidential counselling
• Headspace for Work subscription — free access
• Monthly wellness stipend of $30 for gym/wellness expenses

Details on how to access these resources can be found on the HR Portal.

If you have any questions, please don't hesitate to reach out to the HR team.

Warm regards,
Aiden Lee

• Manager review           — due May 29, 2026

• Adjust your pension/401k contribution rate
• Add or remove dependants
• Enrol in voluntary benefits (dental, vision, life)

• Headspace for Work subscription — free access
• Monthly wellness stipend of $42 for gym/wellness expenses

If you have any questions, please don't hesitate to reach out to the HR team.

• Adjust your pension/401k contribution rate
• Add or remove dependants
• Enrol in voluntary benefits (dental, vision, life)

The annual performance review cycle will open on May 08, 2026. This year's updated framework includes:

• Self-assessment          — due May 17, 2026
• Manager review           — due May 27, 2026

• Adjust your pension/401k contribution rate
• Add or remove dependants
• Enrol in voluntary benefits (dental, vision, life)

Failure to make elections within the window will result in current selections rolling over automatically.

• Headspace for Work subscription — free access
• Monthly wellness stipend of $38 for gym/wellness expenses

Details on how to access these resources can be found on the HR Portal.

If you have any questions, please don't hesitate to reach out to the HR team.

Warm regards,
Joseph Moore

• Adjust your pension/401k contribution rate
• Add or remove dependants

• Add or remove dependants

Subject: HR Notice: Updated Remote Work Policy
Body:
Dear All,

I'm writing to share several important updates from the People & Culture team at Confluent.

────────────────────────────────────────────
1. ANNUAL PERFORMANCE REVIEW — CYCLE OPENING
────────────────────────────────────────────
The annual performance review cycle will open on May 13, 2026. This year's updated framework includes:

• Self-assessment          — due May 20, 2026
• Manager review           — due May 28, 2026
• Calibration sessions     — week of May 12, 2026
• Final ratings communicated by May 15, 2026

All employees should ensure their goals are up-to-date in the performance system before the self-assessment opens.

────────────────────────────────────────────
2. BENEFITS ENROLLMENT WINDOW
────────────────────────────────────────────
The annual benefits enrollment window is open from May 06, 2026 to May 08, 2026. This is your opportunity to:

• Review and update your health insurance plan
• Adjust your pension/401k contribution rate
• Add or remove dependants
• Enrol in voluntary benefits (dental, vision, life)

Failure to make elections within the window will result in current selections rolling over automatically.

────────────────────────────────────────────
3. EMPLOYEE WELLBEING
────────────────────────────────────────────
As a reminder, Confluent offers all employees:
• Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) — free, confidential counselling
• Headspace for Work subscription — free access
• Monthly wellness stipend of $63 for gym/wellness expenses

Details on how to access these resources can be found on the HR Portal.

If you have any questions, please don't hesitate to reach out to the HR team.

Warm regards,
Mary Green
Head of People & Culture | Confluent
+1-828-619-3016

I'm writing to share several important updates from the People & Culture team at Figma.

────────────────────────────────────────────
1. ANNUAL PERFORMANCE REVIEW — CYCLE OPENING
────────────────────────────────────────────
The annual performance review cycle will open on May 05, 2026. This year's updated framework includes:

• Self-assessment          — due May 11, 2026
• Manager review           — due May 04, 2026
• Calibration sessions     — week of May 14, 2026
• Final ratings communicated by June 05, 2026

All employees should ensure their goals are up-to-date in the performance system before the self-assessment opens.

────────────────────────────────────────────

────────────────────────────────────────────
The annual benefits enrollment window is open from May 04, 2026 to May 22, 2026. This is your opportunity to:

• Review and update your health insurance plan
• Adjust your pension/401k contribution rate
• Add or remove dependants
• Enrol in voluntary benefits (dental, vision, life)

Failure to make elections within the window will result in current selections rolling over automatically.

────────────────────────────────────────────

────────────────────────────────────────────
As a reminder, Figma offers all employees:
• Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) — free, confidential counselling
• Headspace for Work subscription — free access
• Monthly wellness stipend of $32 for gym/wellness expenses

Details on how to access these resources can be found on the HR Portal.

If you have any questions, please don't hesitate to reach out to the HR team.

Warm regards,
Lucas Campbell
Head of People & Culture | Figma
+1-666-824-3766

Subject: Reminder: Submit your timesheets by May 05, 2026
Body:
Dear All,

I'm writing to share several important updates from the People & Culture team at Salesforce.

────────────────────────────────────────────
1. ANNUAL PERFORMANCE REVIEW — CYCLE OPENING
────────────────────────────────────────────
The annual performance review cycle will open on May 08, 2026. This year's updated framework includes:

• Self-assessment          — due May 22, 2026
• Manager review           — due May 23, 2026
• Calibration sessions     — week of May 09, 2026
• Final ratings communicated by May 18, 2026

All employees should ensure their goals are up-to-date in the performance system before the self-assessment opens.

────────────────────────────────────────────
2. BENEFITS ENROLLMENT WINDOW
────────────────────────────────────────────
The annual benefits enrollment window is open from May 06, 2026 to May 13, 2026. This is your opportunity to:

• Review and update your health insurance plan
• Adjust your pension/401k contribution rate
• Add or remove dependants
• Enrol in voluntary benefits (dental, vision, life)

Failure to make elections within the window will result in current selections rolling over automatically.

────────────────────────────────────────────
3. EMPLOYEE WELLBEING
────────────────────────────────────────────
As a reminder, Salesforce offers all employees:
• Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) — free, confidential counselling
• Headspace for Work subscription — free access
• Monthly wellness stipend of $50 for gym/wellness expenses

Details on how to access these resources can be found on the HR Portal.

If you have any questions, please don't hesitate to reach out to the HR team.

Warm regards,
Sarah Davis
Head of People & Culture | Salesforce
+1-848-792-9486

Subject: Company Update: Q4 All-Hands Meeting
Body:
Dear All,

I'm writing to share several important updates from the People & Culture team at MongoDB.

────────────────────────────────────────────
1. ANNUAL PERFORMANCE REVIEW — CYCLE OPENING
────────────────────────────────────────────
The annual performance review cycle will open on May 06, 2026. This year's updated framework includes:

• Self-assessment          — due May 20, 2026
• Manager review           — due May 21, 2026
• Calibration sessions     — week of June 01, 2026
• Final ratings communicated by May 17, 2026

All employees should ensure their goals are up-to-date in the performance system before the self-assessment opens.

────────────────────────────────────────────
2. BENEFITS ENROLLMENT WINDOW
────────────────────────────────────────────
The annual benefits enrollment window is open from May 04, 2026 to May 21, 2026. This is your opportunity to:

• Review and update your health insurance plan
• Adjust your pension/401k contribution rate
• Add or remove dependants
• Enrol in voluntary benefits (dental, vision, life)

Failure to make elections within the window will result in current selections rolling over automatically.

────────────────────────────────────────────
3. EMPLOYEE WELLBEING
────────────────────────────────────────────
As a reminder, MongoDB offers all employees:
• Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) — free, confidential counselling
• Headspace for Work subscription — free access
• Monthly wellness stipend of $85 for gym/wellness expenses

Details on how to access these resources can be found on the HR Portal.

If you have any questions, please don't hesitate to reach out to the HR team.

Warm regards,
Emily Lee
Head of People & Culture | MongoDB
+1-272-782-9827

Body:
Dear All,

I'm writing to share several important updates from the People & Culture team at SAP.

────────────────────────────────────────────
1. ANNUAL PERFORMANCE REVIEW — CYCLE OPENING
────────────────────────────────────────────
The annual performance review cycle will open on May 16, 2026. This year's updated framework includes:

• Self-assessment          — due May 08, 2026
• Manager review           — due May 16, 2026
• Calibration sessions     — week of May 24, 2026
• Final ratings communicated by May 27, 2026

All employees should ensure their goals are up-to-date in the performance system before the self-assessment opens.

────────────────────────────────────────────
2. BENEFITS ENROLLMENT WINDOW
────────────────────────────────────────────
The annual benefits enrollment window is open from May 06, 2026 to May 06, 2026. This is your opportunity to:

• Review and update your health insurance plan
• Adjust your pension/401k contribution rate
• Add or remove dependants
• Enrol in voluntary benefits (dental, vision, life)

Failure to make elections within the window will result in current selections rolling over automatically.

────────────────────────────────────────────
3. EMPLOYEE WELLBEING
────────────────────────────────────────────
As a reminder, SAP offers all employees:
• Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) — free, confidential counselling
• Headspace for Work subscription — free access
• Monthly wellness stipend of $36 for gym/wellness expenses

Details on how to access these resources can be found on the HR Portal.

If you have any questions, please don't hesitate to reach out to the HR team.

Warm regards,
Mason Jackson
Head of People & Culture | SAP
+1-269-326-4541

• Add or remove dependants
• Enrol in voluntary benefits (dental, vision, life)

• Headspace for Work subscription — free access

Details on how to access these resources can be found on the HR Portal.

If you have any questions, please don't hesitate to reach out to the HR team.

Warm regards,
William Adams

Harper Hill

• Add or remove dependants
• Enrol in voluntary benefits (dental, vision, life)

Body:
Dear All,

I'm writing to share several important updates from the People & Culture team at Twilio.

────────────────────────────────────────────
1. ANNUAL PERFORMANCE REVIEW — CYCLE OPENING
────────────────────────────────────────────
The annual performance review cycle will open on May 10, 2026. This year's updated framework includes:

• Self-assessment          — due May 06, 2026
• Manager review           — due May 15, 2026
• Calibration sessions     — week of June 01, 2026
• Final ratings communicated by May 21, 2026

All employees should ensure their goals are up-to-date in the performance system before the self-assessment opens.

────────────────────────────────────────────
2. BENEFITS ENROLLMENT WINDOW
────────────────────────────────────────────
The annual benefits enrollment window is open from May 06, 2026 to May 14, 2026. This is your opportunity to:

• Review and update your health insurance plan
• Adjust your pension/401k contribution rate
• Add or remove dependants
• Enrol in voluntary benefits (dental, vision, life)

Failure to make elections within the window will result in current selections rolling over automatically.

────────────────────────────────────────────
3. EMPLOYEE WELLBEING
────────────────────────────────────────────
As a reminder, Twilio offers all employees:
• Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) — free, confidential counselling
• Headspace for Work subscription — free access
• Monthly wellness stipend of $96 for gym/wellness expenses

Details on how to access these resources can be found on the HR Portal.

If you have any questions, please don't hesitate to reach out to the HR team.

Warm regards,
Elijah Lee
Head of People & Culture | Twilio
+1-564-933-2876

• Adjust your pension/401k contribution rate
• Add or remove dependants
• Enrol in voluntary benefits (dental, vision, life)

• Headspace for Work subscription — free access
• Monthly wellness stipend of $94 for gym/wellness expenses

Dear All,

I'm writing to share several important updates from the People & Culture team at MongoDB.

────────────────────────────────────────────
1. ANNUAL PERFORMANCE REVIEW — CYCLE OPENING
────────────────────────────────────────────
The annual performance review cycle will open on May 16, 2026. This year's updated framework includes:

• Self-assessment          — due May 20, 2026
• Manager review           — due May 28, 2026
• Calibration sessions     — week of May 29, 2026
• Final ratings communicated by June 14, 2026

All employees should ensure their goals are up-to-date in the performance system before the self-assessment opens.

────────────────────────────────────────────
2. BENEFITS ENROLLMENT WINDOW
────────────────────────────────────────────
The annual benefits enrollment window is open from May 08, 2026 to May 16, 2026. This is your opportunity to:

• Review and update your health insurance plan
• Adjust your pension/401k contribution rate
• Add or remove dependants
• Enrol in voluntary benefits (dental, vision, life)

Failure to make elections within the window will result in current selections rolling over automatically.

────────────────────────────────────────────

────────────────────────────────────────────
As a reminder, MongoDB offers all employees:
• Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) — free, confidential counselling
• Headspace for Work subscription — free access
• Monthly wellness stipend of $41 for gym/wellness expenses

Details on how to access these resources can be found on the HR Portal.

If you have any questions, please don't hesitate to reach out to the HR team.

Warm regards,
Jessica Thompson

Subject: Reminder: Annual Performance Review Cycle Begins May 16, 2026
Body:
Dear All,

I'm writing to share several important updates from the People & Culture team at Atlassian.

────────────────────────────────────────────
1. ANNUAL PERFORMANCE REVIEW — CYCLE OPENING
────────────────────────────────────────────
The annual performance review cycle will open on May 11, 2026. This year's updated framework includes:

• Self-assessment          — due May 06, 2026
• Manager review           — due May 23, 2026
• Calibration sessions     — week of May 10, 2026
• Final ratings communicated by June 13, 2026

All employees should ensure their goals are up-to-date in the performance system before the self-assessment opens.

────────────────────────────────────────────
2. BENEFITS ENROLLMENT WINDOW
────────────────────────────────────────────
The annual benefits enrollment window is open from May 08, 2026 to May 21, 2026. This is your opportunity to:

• Review and update your health insurance plan
• Adjust your pension/401k contribution rate
• Add or remove dependants
• Enrol in voluntary benefits (dental, vision, life)

Failure to make elections within the window will result in current selections rolling over automatically.

────────────────────────────────────────────
3. EMPLOYEE WELLBEING
────────────────────────────────────────────
As a reminder, Atlassian offers all employees:
• Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) — free, confidential counselling
• Headspace for Work subscription — free access
• Monthly wellness stipend of $76 for gym/wellness expenses

Details on how to access these resources can be found on the HR Portal.

If you have any questions, please don't hesitate to reach out to the HR team.

Warm regards,
Robert Green
Head of People & Culture | Atlassian
+1-483-860-1217

• Self-assessment          — due May 10, 2026

• Review and update your health insurance plan
• Adjust your pension/401k contribution rate
• Add or remove dependants
• Enrol in voluntary benefits (dental, vision, life)

Failure to make elections within the window will result in current selections rolling over automatically.

As a reminder, Workday offers all employees:
• Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) — free, confidential counselling
• Headspace for Work subscription — free access
• Monthly wellness stipend of $36 for gym/wellness expenses

Details on how to access these resources can be found on the HR Portal.

If you have any questions, please don't hesitate to reach out to the HR team.

Warm regards,
Joseph Flores
Head of People & Culture | Workday
+1-659-110-8286

Travel: Planning a trip to Scotland next month. Would love to have a travel buddy if you're free!

Anyway, I don't want this to turn into an essay. Let's actually make plans to catch up. Are you free for a walk sometime in the next couple of weeks? I'm flexible most evenings and weekends.

Would genuinely love to hear how you're doing.

Take care,
Richard Taylor

────────────────────────────────────────────

• Review and update your health insurance plan
• Adjust your pension/401k contribution rate
• Add or remove dependants
• Enrol in voluntary benefits (dental, vision, life)

• Review and update your health insurance plan
• Adjust your pension/401k contribution rate
• Add or remove dependants
• Enrol in voluntary benefits (dental, vision, life)

• Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) — free, confidential counselling
• Headspace for Work subscription — free access
• Monthly wellness stipend of $96 for gym/wellness expenses

Details on how to access these resources can be found on the HR Portal.

If you have any questions, please don't hesitate to reach out to the HR team.

Body:
Dear All,

I'm writing to share several important updates from the People & Culture team at Confluent.

────────────────────────────────────────────
1. ANNUAL PERFORMANCE REVIEW — CYCLE OPENING
────────────────────────────────────────────
The annual performance review cycle will open on May 07, 2026. This year's updated framework includes:

• Self-assessment          — due May 16, 2026
• Manager review           — due May 21, 2026
• Calibration sessions     — week of May 19, 2026
• Final ratings communicated by May 04, 2026

All employees should ensure their goals are up-to-date in the performance system before the self-assessment opens.

────────────────────────────────────────────
2. BENEFITS ENROLLMENT WINDOW
────────────────────────────────────────────
The annual benefits enrollment window is open from May 07, 2026 to May 06, 2026. This is your opportunity to:

• Review and update your health insurance plan
• Adjust your pension/401k contribution rate
• Add or remove dependants
• Enrol in voluntary benefits (dental, vision, life)

Failure to make elections within the window will result in current selections rolling over automatically.

────────────────────────────────────────────
3. EMPLOYEE WELLBEING
────────────────────────────────────────────
As a reminder, Confluent offers all employees:
• Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) — free, confidential counselling
• Headspace for Work subscription — free access
• Monthly wellness stipend of $60 for gym/wellness expenses

Details on how to access these resources can be found on the HR Portal.

If you have any questions, please don't hesitate to reach out to the HR team.

Warm regards,
Olivia Nguyen

Life: Finally got the flat sorted after the big move. It has been an adjustment but a good one overall.

Travel: Planning a trip to Italy in the spring. Would love to have a travel buddy if you're free!

Anyway, I don't want this to turn into an essay. Let's actually make plans to catch up. Are you free for a walk sometime in the next couple of weeks? I'm flexible most evenings and weekends.

Subject: Long time no speak!

Hey Mia,

I hope this email finds you well! I know we've both been terrible at keeping in touch lately but I've been thinking about you and wanted to reach out properly rather than just sending a message that gets buried.

So — how are you? What's new? Fill me in!

On my end, things have been a whirlwind. Here's a brief update:

Work: Things have been really busy but rewarding. It is challenging but I am learning a lot

Life: Finally got the flat sorted after the big move. It has been an adjustment but a good one overall.

Travel: Planning a trip to Italy in the spring. Would love to have a travel buddy if you're free!

Anyway, I don't want this to turn into an essay. Let's actually make plans to catch up. Are you free for a walk sometime in the next couple of weeks? I'm flexible most evenings and weekends.

Would genuinely love to hear how you're doing.

Take care,
Richard Flores

P.S. Hope the family is all well!
